cap_footprint.description: Cap projection must fit the hull of its actual supports plus declared socket/head material. Does not require four pegs or prove structural minimality.

minimal_in_plane_support.description: Exclude jaws. Only 3 mm pivot sleeves through Y=-3..3; local retainers within diameter 5 mm below, including 0.01 mm tessellation allowance. No lower connecting plate/rear pillars. Strength and true structural minimum unverified.

outside_contacts.description: 8 mm outward X approach, 3 mm patch at Z=15/25/35, Y=-2.5..2.5, over 121 poses. CAD access only; no hand model, skin pressure or ergonomics claim.

peg_placement.description: Support orientation/removal has no prescribed direction or peg count. Measured occupied band and outside contact collisions are the evidence; redundant load paths require stiffness/strength evidence.

full_stroke.limitation: Sampled 0–30 degree stroke, not continuous collision proof. Probes omit intentional spline/thread engagement; center probe covers only exposed retaining head. No pair exclusions. Volume tolerance 0.0001 mm^3 covers STL face rounding at seated planes.

tool_access.limitation: Driver shaft envelopes: near ear screws require 10 degree tilt; straight access fails. Physical engagement of tilted PH0 driver unverified. Install plate/spline retaining screw before pinion; finger bosses seat before cap. Physical tool handles, resin fits and real cable bend unverified.

retention.description: Blind pivot sockets and two M3 pillars retained. Stiffness, post bending, screw pullout and axial endplay need physical/load tests.

human_contact.description: Finger band unchanged; no measured human hand or pressure model. CAD corridor success is not human fit.
